description: This file defines the PricingResolutionFlow class, which manages the process of resolving effective prices for products based on store, SKU, currency, quantity, and optional timestamp. It interacts with a repository to fetch prices, validates inputs, applies sale or regular prices depending on sale windows, and returns a pricing resolution object with detailed price info.

classes.name: PricingResolutionFlow
classes.description: Manages the price resolution process for SKUs, including validation, fetching prices from the repository, determining sale or regular prices, and returning detailed pricing information.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main method that calculates the effective price based on request parameters, including validating inputs, fetching the active price, determining applicable price type (sale or regular), and constructing the result.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Ensures the request object contains all required and correctly formatted data, such as non-null, non-blank store code, SKU, 3-letter currency code, and positive quantity.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Helper method to check if a string is null or empty after trimming.

methods.name: determineAppliedPrice
methods.description: Decides whether to apply a sale or regular price based on sale price existence and sale window timing.

methods.name: isWithinSaleWindow
methods.description: Checks if a given timestamp 'at' falls within the sale window defined by optional start and end offsets.
